_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: README: Windows only, installed through r2modman with the game from Steam or Epic
_ap_world_name_source: worlds/hades2rogue/archipelago.json: "game": "Hades2Rogue". The world's game name is NOT the game's name -- a seed's slot says Hades2Rogue, not Hades II. Getting this wrong makes Join fail with a game the room has never heard of.
description: Supergiant's Hades II as a multiworld.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: a commercial game the player buys on Steam or Epic
_mod_kind_source: not a remake -- this is the commercial release

client.name: Hades 2 Client
client._kind_source: README: "Search for the Hades 2 Client in the archipelago launcher". The world ships its own client.
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: README: "Download the APWorld from the releases tab"; latest v0.9.3

_install_kind_source: README: the apworld into custom_worlds, PLUS the Hades2RogueArchipelago mod installed through r2modman from Thunderstore. London carries neither the game nor a mod manager, so the mod step is the player's.
setup: Install r2modman, then pick Hades 2 and the store you own it on.
In r2modman, find Hades2RogueArchipelago online and Download with Dependencies.
Download Hades2Rogue.apworld from the release into Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Start the Hades 2 Client from the Archipelago launcher.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.
